definitions.explanation: An attractive quality suggesting sensuality or romantic appeal. Can describe both men and women.
A desire or aspiration for something, often used in the expression {色気|いろけ}を{出|だ}す (to show interest/ambition for something beyond one's usual scope).

examples.japanese: {色気|いろけ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{色気|いろけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: That actor has a mature charm.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ダンス→ダンス：03856_dansu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{色気|いろけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{魅了|みりょう}した→魅了する：19016_miryousuru⟧。
examples.english: Her dancing had an allure that captivated the audience.

examples.japanese: {色気|いろけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧な。
⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ポスト→ポスト：02965_posuto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{色気|いろけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: To show ambition for the company president position.

examples.japanese: ⟦{余計|よけい}→余計：04090_yokei⟧な{色気|いろけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧せい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、かえって⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。
examples.english: Because I got greedy and tried for too much, I ended up failing instead.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧ (color, but also romantic/sexual connotation) and {気|け} (air, feeling). The word carries a range from subtle allure to overt sensuality depending on context.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {色気|いろけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ — to have sex appeal
- {色気|いろけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ — to show interest/ambition (sense 2); to try to be seductive (sense 1)
- {色気|いろけ}⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧ — full of allure
- ⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{色気|いろけ} — mature charm
- {色気|いろけ}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{食|く}い{気|け} — appetite over romance (proverb)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{魅力|みりょく}→魅力：03749_miryoku⟧ — charm, attractiveness (broader, not necessarily sexual)
- セクシー — sexy (direct loanword, more casual)
- ⟦{艶|つや}→艶：03893_tsuya⟧ — gloss, luster, also used for sensual beauty (literary)
